versions.subject: Merge PR #4900 from @jamesc-grafana - Add new AWS cloudtrail rules
versions.detection:
selection:
    userIdentity.arn|re: '.+:assumed-role/aws:.+'
filter_main_generic:
    - eventSource: 'ssm.amazonaws.com'
    - eventName: 'RegisterManagedInstance'
    - sourceIPAddress: 'AWS Internal'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: NOT (eventSource="ssm.amazonaws.com" OR eventName="RegisterManagedInstance" OR sourceIPAddress="AWS Internal") | regex userIdentity.arn=".+:assumed-role/aws:.+"
